info.name: 16 - Reports
info.description: Endpoints to generate revenue, expense, attendance reports with date range filtering, chart data, and attendance dashboard.

request.description:
Retrieves the gym attendance dashboard containing statistics and recent check-ins.

### Route Parameters

| Parameter | Type | Required | Description |
| :--- | :--- | :--- | :--- |
| `gymId` | `int` | Yes | Target gym ID (must match `CurrentGymId`) |

### Response (`GymAttendanceDashboardRDTO`)

### Authorization
Requires gym role `Owner`, `Manager`, `Receptionist`, or `Coach`.

Generates a revenue report for a gym within a date range.

### Route Parameters

| Parameter | Type | Required | Description |
| :--- | :--- | :--- | :--- |
| `gymId` | `int` | Yes | Target gym ID (must match `CurrentGymId`) |

### Query Parameters

| Parameter | Type | Required | Description |
| :--- | :--- | :--- | :--- |
| `fromDate` | `DateTime` | Yes | Report start date (ISO format). Cannot be in the future. |
| `toDate` | `DateTime` | Yes | Report end date (ISO format). Must be >= `fromDate`. |

### Response (`RevenueReportRDTO`)

### Authorization
Requires gym role `Owner` or `Manager`. SuperAdmin bypasses all gym checks.
